implementation_notes: Implements EMA teacher/student latent target regression for expression patches.
Targets are layer-normalized averages of top-K teacher layers, predicted only at masked patch positions.
No external pretrained data2vec checkpoint is loaded.
Auxiliary masked expression reconstruction is retained for scMAE-family fairness.
mask_semantics: 1 = expression patch replaced by learned data2vec mask token
